changelog: Phase 3 - the features that were listed but broken are now real. Encryption key rotation actually works: set PREVIOUS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, restart, click Rotate in admin dashboard. Every mailbox password, AI key, and integration credential is re-encrypted with the new key while the app stays live. DNSBL check now queries proper domain-based blocklists (Spamhaus DBL, SURBL, URIBL) instead of the meaningless IP lookup of the sending domain - the check now works uniformly for Gmail/Outlook OAuth users and self-hosted SMTP. New local warmup pool mode: set WARMUP_MODE=local to cycle warmup emails between your own mailboxes with no phone-home. Full-text trigram indexes added to lead search: 100k-row LIKE queries drop from full-scan to ~50ms.
